profiles.name: SDXL-Lightning (ByteDance, few-step)
profiles.settings: Use the 2/4/8-step checkpoint or LoRA with matching steps, CFG 0–1 (negative prompt has little effect at CFG ≤1), Euler sampler with sgm_uniform / trailing timesteps.
profiles.ai_guidance: SDXL-Lightning: concise comma-separated SDXL-style descriptive phrases, subject first; keep it under ~75 tokens; avoid relying on a negative prompt.
tips: Match the step count to the checkpoint (2, 4 or 8 steps).
CFG 0–1: put exclusions into the positive prompt.
